defects: `Ideal.span R (↑S : Set R)` misuses the `Ideal.span` API: `Ideal.span` has signature `(s : Set α) : Ideal α` with the ring `α` implicit (inferred from `s`), not an explicit first argument — this is likely confused with `Submodule.span`'s explicit-ring signature, and as written does not type-check (passing `R : Type*` where a `Set R` is expected).
